objective:
Goal: a page offering to download the article as a PDF is shown. Reach it from the current page by clicking through the visible UI, by any route. Never type a URL or use the address bar.
Hint: an old tutorial said "Click Download as PDF to have Wikipedia automatically generate a PDF copy of this article.", but those labels may have moved or been renamed.
When the goal is met, verify it on screen. If the page you end on has a main heading, store it as 'landed_on'; a page without a heading is fine.
